facts.fact: The University of Tasmania researchers behind the wombat-poo study won the 2019 Ig Nobel Physics Prize.
To see how the gut makes the cubes, researchers inflated a piece of the last section of a wombat's intestine with a small balloon.
Bare-nosed wombats may poop up to 100 cubes a day; the cubes are about 2 centimeters in size.
Scientists suspect the cube shape lets wombats mark their territory on rocks and logs with poop that won't easily roll away.
